pages.title: Trolls
text: Big, slow to fall and quick to anger. Three kinds of troll keep the March's high stone and its heat, and all three hunt you.

pages.title: Crag Troll
text: Found in the Highlands. It rises on the open ground at night, one or two at a time.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 March Leather, 1 to 2 Bones and up to 2 Flint.

pages.title: Rime Troll
text: Found in the Snow Fields. It rises on the open ground at night, one or two at a time.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 March Leather, 1 to 2 Bones and 1 to 3 Snowballs.

pages.title: Slag Troll
text: Found in the Ember Wastes, by lava and on the hot stone around it, day or night, one or two at a time. It is **immune to fire**.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 March Leather, 1 to 2 Bones and 1 to 3 Iron Nuggets.

pages.title: Fighting one
text: A troll has **69 health** and **6 armour** and hits for **9**. A Crag or Rime Troll's blow shoves you back; a Slag Troll's sets you alight for 2 seconds.
Keep your distance, and never fight one with lava at your back.

pages.title: What they give
text: Each drops **1 to 2** of its hide, more with Looting. **Troll Hide** and **Rime Hide** are Shove reagents, **Slag Hide** an Ember reagent: see [reagents](reagents).

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting.
